name: Chilean Sign Language
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Sign language; only sublexical-structure study (Adamo 1993) and syntax/survey works (Pilleux et al. 1991, Parks 2009/2011) found; no word-stress description applicable or located.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 languoid page chil1264 and reference records 319867, 568021, 578154
sources.note: Three descriptive references only (grammar 1991, phonology thesis 1993, aspect thesis 2015); none flagged for stress.

sources.citation: Aristegui, Daniela; Garfias, Daniela; Moyano, Carla. 2018. Descripción de la referencia temporal en la lengua de señas chilena. Lenguas Modernas 52: 57-71.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: p. 61: generic four-parameter description of sign phonology (configuración manual, ubicación, movimiento, orientación) citing Crasborn & van der Kooij 2016, illustrated with an LSCh sign from Acuña et al. 2009; nothing on stress. Its literature review (p. 61-62) names the LSCh descriptive works: Pilleux & Ávalos 1991, Adamo 1993, Cabrera 1993, Saldías 2015, Cisternas 2018, Acuña 2016.

sources.citation: Adamo Quintela, Dora; Acuña Robertson, Ximena; Cabrera Ramírez, Irene. 2013. Diccionario bilingüe lengua de señas chilena/español: Un desafío lexicográfico. RLA. Revista de Lingüística Teórica y Aplicada 51(2): 173-192. doi:10.4067/S0718-48832013000200009
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Section 2.3 (pp. 181-182) lists the sublexical constituents of LSCh signs (configuración de las manos, movimiento, lugar, orientación, rasgos no manuales), citing Adamo (1994 [=1993]); nothing on stress, accent, prominence or prosody. First-hand by the UMCE research team.

sources.citation: Acuña Robertson, Ximena; Adamo Quintela, Dora; Cabrera Ramírez, Irene. 2009. Diccionario Bilingüe Lengua de Señas Chilena-Español, Tomos I-II. Santiago: Universidad Metropolitana de Ciencias de la Educación / MINEDUC. ISBN 978-956-7062-61-4
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Prologue, introduction and usage notes (pp. 3-14) say only that LSCh has phonological, morphological, syntactic levels; no phonological sketch and nothing on stress. a full-text search for stress/accent both volumes for acento/acentu/prosod/énfasis/intensidad/fonolog finds only the Spanish lexical entry ACENTO (tilde).

sources.citation: Acuña Robertson, Ximena. 2016. La metáfora en la lengua de señas chilena: una aproximación desde la psicolingüística cognitiva. PhD thesis, Universidad de Valladolid.
